title: Apply one edit without changing the source
prompt: Export edit(tasks: readonly Task[], id: string, done: boolean): Task[]. Task has id:string and done:boolean. Return tasks in the same order, replacing done for every matching id. Unmatched tasks keep their values. Do not mutate the source array or its objects.
hints: Select rows by exact ID before changing their status.
Mapping creates a new array but does not itself copy its objects.
Create a new object when replacing a matching row.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Updates every row instead of the selected ID.

witness.detail: Cannot assign to read only property 'done'

feedback: Select rows by exact ID before changing their status.
